resident_reference_definition: Resident means all routed-expert weights resident, independently restored from the identical prepared bytes using B1 native/bitsandbytes reconstruction. Non-expert layers retain the same public streaming setup. This is not mislabeled as a full-resident-model run.
reference: Independent native-expert resident ordinary gradient accumulation; compare public sequential/grouped/Triton ordinary and L2L paths. Also compare each resident/streamed backend pair with identical expert arithmetic and dispatch policy.

data.kind: synthetic token IDs/targets through all sixteen pretrained OLMoE layers
data.input_range: CPU torch.Generator seed 1729; randint(3, config.vocab_size), shape 7x512
data.labels: copy input IDs; labels[:,0]=-100 and every eleventh position=-100
data.row_order: Public Trainer sampler seed 29. Retain and compare actual delivered row/token/label hashes per accumulation window.
data.label_denominator: Exact number of nonignored shifted next-token labels in each actual accumulation window, including the one-row final window.

adapter_initialization: Prepare and pin complete attention LoRA initial factors before freeze. Load matching values after each Trainer setup, preserving actual per-codec adapter dtype (dense FP32; TRL QLoRA BF16). Save dtype/shape/raw bytes and initial state hashes.

numerics.autocast: Explicit CUDA BF16, including all matching save/reload evaluation paths
numerics.evaluation_output: FP32 logits on both prepared-Trainer and restored-Trainer paths
numerics.attention_implementation: Record and require identical native implementation across all cells; no attention/CE/kernel patch may differ between arms.

numerical_gates.forward: Exact logits/loss/routing and expert outputs, separately stated.
numerical_gates.backward: Exact input/router gradients in every trained decoder layer and every trainable attention-LoRA parameter; finite values, nonzero effective gradients.
numerical_gates.adapter_updates: Exact complete adapter state after every real optimizer step; prove a nonzero change from initial state.
numerical_gates.A_A: Reset initial parameters, optimizer, sampler and CPU/CUDA RNG; two same-process runs reproduce every step, gradients and updates exactly.
numerical_gates.negative: In the same process, add +0.5 to column 0 of the lexicographically first v_proj lora_B before a reset replay. Logits and at least one nonzero gradient must differ; an ineffective control gives no verdict, not a larger perturbation or relaxed threshold.
numerical_gates.restored: Restore the exact initial factors, optimizer and RNG after the fixed negative control; replay must match the original exactly.
numerical_gates.save_reload: Save through wrapper.train(), construct the same public Trainer/dtype recipe, load the saved adapter; factors/dtypes/logits must match exactly. Repeat for ordinary SFT and L2L.
numerical_gates.same_kernel_resident_streamed: Native per-expert loop paired with native sequential; grouped resident with grouped stream; Triton resident with Triton stream. Keep matrix geometry, row dispatch, activation rounding and scatter order identical within each pair.

streaming.resident_oracles: Separate correctness-only processes; never left resident during streamed memory/timing arms.
streaming.dispatch: Native at rows 1..128 and 481+; grouped at 129..480. Empty experts skipped. Require positive grouped dispatch and executed Triton activation for relevant candidate cells; no data-dependent fallback.

grouping.meaning: sequential versus grouped including restore/load/gather/scatter and optimizer window

activation.meaning: grouped native activation versus grouped Triton activation, same pool and GEMM

timing_definition: Fresh Linux process per arm. Prepare model and compile/JIT outside the timer. Time complete public Trainer optimizer windows, synchronized at declared boundaries. First full two-row step is warmup; retain the following two full windows and final one-row window as three samples. Primary arm value=sum(wall_seconds)/2560 input tokens. Report every raw step and actual input/target token counts; do not assume 1024 tokens in the partial last window. The pre-optimizer callback stops/synchronizes the forward/backward timer before CPU gradient hashing, then resumes a separate optimizer segment. Stop at on_step_end before parameter hashes; sum both measured segments. Both arms use this same boundary. Precompile all 512 possible Triton row shapes and pool widths before warmup. Hash actual delivered input/label windows outside these segments and compare all parameter gradients/updates to the native oracle.
repeat_rule: For each codec/training stratum, project each shared six-arm symmetric block into two actual ABBA pairs. Reuse unchanged arm_validity.repeats: sigma=sqrt((var(A)+var(B))/2), delta=0.10*mean(A), N=max(2,ceil(7.85*(sigma/delta)^2)). Joint first target=max(5,N_grouping,N_activation) from five pilot blocks. At that joint target recompute once from that prefix; joint final target=max(first,N_grouping,N_activation). No later top-up. If target exceeds ten, retain records and report no-verdict precision budget; never discard/replace a void block.
profiles: One independent profiler process per codec/training/backend after warmup. Retain CUPTI Chrome trace, actual cat=kernel ph=X events, complete kernel names, per-layer route histograms and native/grouped matrix counts. Total device launch count is primary; name-based decode/GEMM/activation/scatter attribution is descriptive, with ambiguous kernels explicitly unassigned rather than guessed. CPU op counts are not CUDA launch counts. Missing device events gives no verdict. Profile the first post-warmup optimizer window only; route histograms run on CPU without extra GPU counting kernels. Profile instrumentation is not timing evidence.
memory: Separate training allocated/reserved peaks after warmup/reset, before evaluation/reload; synchronize. Record whole-child peak RSS, pinned/staging/arena budgets separately. F1 retains clock records; device-before/after CSV records memory, temperature and power endpoints (not telemetry peaks). No activation-only or optimizer-only result is called total-VRAM reduction.
budget_enforcement: Create one exclusive session marker for the actual source commit, outside user-selectable output names. Record every started child, argv, exit, timeout and exception. At a failure or time/cell budget stop, retain everything and create no replacement/new session under this rule. A new attempt needs a new prospective rule/source commit.

hardware.capacity_basis: Trello/source end-to-end Linux card requirement is 16 GiB+. The actual RTX4090 reports 25,250,627,584 CUDA-visible bytes; GPU UUID/driver remain pinned. An earlier unexecuted draft threshold 25,501,368,320 exceeded this value and was rejected during final host readiness.

validity: Reuse unchanged arm_validity.ArmWatch and empirical sysfs/guest mapping. Before freeze verify all prepared shard hashes and paths, baseline OK, complete aligned own-shard reads OK and an independent foreign O_DIRECT reader VOID. The existing 2 GiB fixture is instrument readiness only, not actual-shard acceptance. Require per-cell F1 OK, unchanged boot/data/source identities and the sole exposed CUDA workload. Missing required sensors, unknown/void F1, visible foreign workloads, restart or identity changes stop the series with no verdict; physical host/cache isolation remains uncertified.

decision.pass: All planned correctness and profile cells and repeat-calculated complete timing blocks satisfy exact source/data/control/validity gates. Mark qualification complete pending independent review, not D3 task acceptance.
decision.fail: Any exact numerical or restored-state mismatch; any accepted use of a different expert arithmetic/kernel policy within a resident/streamed pair.
decision.no_verdict: OOM, interruption, timeout, missing/effective-negative control, missing GPU traces, unknown/void validity, inactive required grouped/Triton path, data/source/hardware drift or exhausted precision/attempt budget.
decision.speed: A positive speedup or reduced total VRAM is not required to pass numerical qualification. Report slower and unchanged results without hiding them.

Frozen experts plus attention LoRA; no routed-expert LoRA, nonzero router auxiliary loss, second derivatives or full-weight fine-tuning.
Ordinary/L2L results are specific to this source, GPU and recipe; A3 Mistral noise-floor/tolerance criteria do not relax D3 byte exactness.
Staged grouped NF4 restoration plus GEMM is not one fused packed-weight GEMM kernel.
